title: End Grain Chopping Board – Premium Walnut, 36 x 24 x 2.5 cm
descriptionHtml:
Elevate your cooking with an exclusive chopping board in solid walnut. This end grain chopping board isn't just an elegant addition to your kitchen – it's also built to last and to be gentle on your knives.

Thanks to the unique structure of end grain timber, the board ”self-heals” small cut marks, so it keeps its fine surface even with daily use. At the same time, the material protects your knife's edge, keeping your knives sharper for longer.

Every board is carefully handcrafted with high precision, making it both a practical tool and a stylish detail in the kitchen. It's robust enough for meat and firmer produce, but works just as well for bread, vegetables and fruit.

Features:

  • Premium end grain walnut

  • Dimensions: 36 x 24 x 2.5 cm

  • Self-healing surface that reduces cut marks

  • Gentle on knives – keeps the edge sharper for longer

  • Robust and durable – built for daily use

  • Elegant design suited to both food prep and serving

A chopping board for those who value quality, function and design in one product. Perfect as a gift or as an investment in your own kitchen.

title: Stainless Steel BBQ Hotplate – Perfect for Meat, Veggies & Smash Burgers
descriptionHtml:
Turn your BBQ into a versatile outdoor kitchen with this rugged stainless steel BBQ hotplate.
Perfect for cooking meat, fish, veggies, eggs, pancakes, smash burgers and plenty more, right on the BBQ. The smooth stainless steel surface spreads heat evenly and makes it easy to cook for the whole family or a backyard full of guests.

Measuring 43.18 cm x 32.51 cm x 5.58 cm, the hotplate fits most standard BBQs and is big enough to handle several ingredients at once. The raised edges stop food and fat from running over, making cooking smoother and cleaner.

Features:

  • Made from hard-wearing stainless steel – built to last

  • Generous size: 43.18 x 32.51 x 5.58 cm

  • Even heat distribution for a perfect sear

  • High edges prevent fat and food spills

  • Easy to clean and maintain

  • Makes your BBQ more versatile – from meat and fish to pancakes and veggies

Why choose a BBQ hotplate?

A BBQ hotplate is a must for anyone who wants to take their barbecuing to the next level. It gives you that teppanyaki or griddle feel and lets you cook food that would otherwise be tricky or impossible on standard grill grates.

Perfect for weeknight dinners and big BBQ nights alike – with the hotplate you get more variety, better control and, above all, more fun cooking!
